pairs: Also, there were the sons of Reuben,
the firstborn of Israel. For indeed, he was his firstborn,
sed cum violasset thorum patris sui,
but when he had violated the bed of his father,
data sunt primogenita ejus filiis Joseph filii Israël,
his right as firstborn was given to the sons of Joseph,
et non est ille reputatus in primogenitum.
the son of Israel, and he was not reputed as firstborn.
qui erat fortissimus inter fratres suos,
who was strongest among his brothers,
de stirpe ejus principes germinati sunt: primogenita autem reputata sunt Joseph.)
from his stock leaders sprung up, but the right of firstborn was reputed to Joseph.
quem captivum duxit Thelgathphalnasar rex Assyriorum,
whom Tilgath-pilneser, the king of the Assyrians, led away captive,
et fuit princeps in tribu Ruben.
and he was a leader in the tribe of Reuben.
when they were being numbered according to their families,
Porro Bala filius Azaz filii Samma filii Joël,
Now Bela, the son of Azaz, the son of Shema,
ipse habitavit in Aroër usque ad Nebo,
the son of Joel, lived in Aroer,
as far as Nebo and Baalmeon.
Contra orientalem quoque plagam habitavit usque ad introitum eremi, et flumen Euphraten.
And he lived toward the eastern region, as far as the entrance to the wilderness and the river Euphrates.
Multum quippe jumentorum numerum possidebant in terra Galaad.
For indeed, they possessed a great number of cattle in the land of Gilead.
In diebus autem Saul præliati sunt contra Agareos,
Then, in the days of Saul, they battled against the Hagarites and put them to death.
And they lived in place of them,
habitaveruntque pro eis in tabernaculis eorum, in omni plaga quæ respicit ad orientem Galaad.
in their dwellings, throughout the entire region that looks to the east of Gilead.
Filii vero Gad e regione eorum habitaverunt in terra Basan usque Selcha:
Truly, the sons of Gad lived in the opposite region from them, in the land of Bashan, as far as Salecah:
Fratres vero eorum secundum domos cognationum suarum,
Truly, their brothers, according to the houses of their kindred,
These were the sons of Abihail,
the sons of Abdiel, the son of Guni,
the leader of the house, in their families,
and in all the suburbs of Sharon,
Omnes hi numerati sunt in diebus Joathan regis Juda,
All these were numbered in the days of Jotham, the king of Judah,
et in diebus Jeroboam regis Israël.
and in the days of Jeroboam, the king of Israel:
and the one half tribe of Manasseh,
quadraginta quatuor millia et septingenti sexaginta,
forty-four thousand and seven hundred sixty,
and Nodab offered assistance to them.
præbuerunt eis auxilium. Traditique sunt in manus eorum Agarei,
And the Hagarites were delivered into their hands,
et universi qui fuerant cum eis,
and all who were with them.
For they called upon God while they did battle.
because they had trusted in him.
And they seized all that they possessed,
and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand,
and of men one hundred thousand lives.
For it was a war of the Lord.
Habitaveruntque pro eis usque ad transmigrationem.
And they lived in place of them, until the transmigration.
Filii quoque dimidiæ tribus Manasse possederunt terram a finibus Basan usque Baal,
Also, the sons of the one half tribe of Manasseh possessed the land, from the parts of Bashan as far as Baal,
For certainly, their number was immense.
Et hi fuerunt principes domus cognationis eorum:
And these were leaders of the house of their kindred:
et nominati duces in familiis suis.
and renowned leaders in their families.
But they abandoned the God of their fathers,
et fornicati sunt post deos populorum terræ,
and they fornicated after the gods of the peoples of the land,
whom God took away before them.
Et suscitavit Deus Israël spiritum Phul regis Assyriorum,
And so the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul, the king of the Assyrians,
and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser, the king of Assur.
and the one half tribe of Manasseh.
And he led them to Halah,
and to Habor, and to Hara,
et fluvium Gozan, usque ad diem hanc.
and to the river of Gozan, even to this day.
